mapper.select: SELECT MIN(q.id) id,q.starts_at,q.ends_at FROM vi_quota_slot q JOIN vi_station s ON s.id=q.station_id AND s.enabled=1 JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=s.dept_id AND d.status='0' AND d.del_flag='0' WHERE q.quota_type='PICKUP' AND q.enabled=1 AND q.starts_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND q.starts_at >= #{start,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler} AND q.starts_at < #{end,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler} AND q.total_quota > q.held_quota+q.confirmed_quota+q.consumed_quota GROUP BY q.starts_at,q.ends_at ORDER BY q.starts_at,q.ends_at
